races.display_title: Kenny Developments Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: IT'S TIME FOR A RUN may have been well held in 2 maiden hurdles last winter but the fact he won a bumper for new trainer Emmet Mullins at Downpatrick in July suggests he could prove a totally different proposition now resuming his hurdle career. En Or was a good third when last seen over hurdles and gets the nod for the forecast spot ahead of Wonderful Everyday , who has only managed a pair of fifths in similar races this summer but retains potential for a top stable based on bumper form. ITS TIME FOR A RUN (IRE) EN OR (FR) WONDERFUL EVERYDAY (IRE)

races.display_title: Anglo Printers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: EURO MAKER has had the form of his Ballinrobe success boosted by the second winning since so Adrian Murray's 5-y-o could still be well treated off 6 lb higher. Crowsatedappletart probably shouldn't have his latest Cork sixth as evidence that he can't make an impact from his lower hurdle mark. races.display_title: Deacy Gilligan Hurdle
races.verdict: Not the easiest race to assess but it could pay to side with PAUL'S DREAM who can bag a third hurdling success of the season at the chief expense of Grann's Boy who comes here on the back of a career-best victory here last month. Veteran French Dynamite has an absence to overcome but is weighted to go well if ready to roll. PAUL'S DREAM (IRE) GRANN'S BOY (IRE) FRENCH DYNAMITE (FR)

races.display_title: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Cases can be made for several of these, and it could pay to take a chance on sole chasing-debutant JUSTATAN , who is bred for this discipline (successful on both starts in points) and upped his game when third over hurdles here at the Festival last month. Smallcraftwarning is only 2 lb higher than when scoring at Kilbeggan on Friday so he's most feared, ahead of Granville Street and Brandt . JUSTATAN (FR) SMALLCRAFTWARNING (IRE) GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)

races.display_title: Kenny Developments Irish EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict: BRICKFIELD BELLE has shown ability both over hurdles and in a bumper and is fancied to make a winning return from almost 6 months off. Streamhill has a solid record in bumpers and can make the placings, while Lake Pippaway was better than the result on her debut and can progress. BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE) STREAMHILL (IRE) LAKE PIPPAWAY (IRE)
